title.en: An Act Prohibiting the Exportation of Antiques of the Philippine Islands

text.en:
The antiques of the Philippine Islands, such as coins, arms, tools, furniture, decorations,
manuscripts, ships and their separate parts, articles of adornment, stones with inscriptions or figures,
agricultural implements, sculptures, carvings, and other works or articles of art, industry and commerce shall
not be exported from the country without the prior authorization of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural
Resources: Provided, That only such objects as are more than one hundred years old shall be considered

Any person violating this provision or an accomplice thereto shall be liable to a fine not
exceeding two thousand five hundred pesos. The confiscation of the objects in question or the payment of
their value to the Treasury of the Philippine Islands shall be at the discretion of the Secretary of Agriculture
and Natural Resources: Provided, further, That each application to the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural
Resources shall be accompanied by a fee of two pesos.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 13, 1931.
